speaker: Doctor
text: Has your mother noticed any petechiae (tiny red spots) on her skin or if her gums bleed easily? Additionally, do you have any bone or joint pain in your hips, back, or knees?

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia (likely ALL).
The clinical presentation of fatigue, bruising, fever, and severe bone pain in a 4-year-old is highly suggestive of leukemia.
I request the results of a Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential, Coagulation Profile (PT/PTT), and a Bone Marrow Biopsy.
REQUEST TEST: CBC_with_diff, Coagulation_Profile, Bone_Marrow_Biopsy
